question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.

The new policy has _____ the use of plastic bags in the store.
solution:
The correct answer is '**banned**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**banned**" means to prohibit or restrict something officially. (प्रतिबंधित)
 
• The sentence indicates that the new policy has officially prohibited the use of plastic bags in the store.
 
• The other options: "**bond**," "**bend**," and "**band**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The new policy has banned__ the use of plastic bags in the store.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bond (बंधन)**: means a connection or tie between people or things.
 
• **Bend (झुकना)**: means to curve or change the shape.
 
• **Band (बैंड)**: means a group of musicians or a strip used for binding.
